notable_absence.finding: The page states a topology-change constraint on the whole DDL statement family ('No CREATE/DROP or CONNECT/DISCONNECT statement can be executed while the cluster topology changes (e.g. during rebalance). The evaluation of such DDL statements will fail and it can be reattempted after the topology change has completed') that was not modeled as a relation: hasExecutionConstraint's registry examples target a single-statement/single-node-routing shape, and there is no promoted 'rebalance' or 'topology change' concept in this batch's visible registry state to serve as its object. Recorded here rather than forced with a mismatched or invented object concept.

cross_component_finding: This page is where the round's LICENSED EQUIVALENCE and DIALECT WARNING meet concretely. The licensed sentence ('may be referred to as a local Analytics collection, or simply as an Analytics collection without qualification') is applied here to fold analytics:local-analytics-collection into analytics:analytics-collection from the first mint, per the context file's instruction. Separately, this page's CREATE ANALYTICS INDEX statement (materialized over an Analytics collection/dataset, typed index fields BIGINT/DOUBLE/STRING, array-index UNNEST/SELECT syntax) was kept as analytics:create-analytics-index rather than folded into the promoted n1ql:create-index, even though both statements share the keywords CREATE...INDEX and even the same syntax for typed fields - this page never states they are the same statement, and 6_n1ql.md (elsewhere in this batch) explicitly states the opposite: 'CREATE INDEX ... Supported but different (e.g., typed)'.
